response.rationale: C1 integrates the lichenoid clinical morphology (flat-topped papules, pruritus) with the decisive histopath findings of bandlike lymphocytic infiltration and epidermal atrophy, making it the most complete supplied diagnosis. R2 captures only follicular keratotic features (whitish papules, folliculocentricity, keratin plugs) and lacks the lichenoid/atrophic histopathology. R1 is a correlated less-specific restatement of C1; R3/R4 and the acquired completions are even less supported. Residual homogenized collagen and follicular plugging are not fully explained by C1, hence medium margin.

rejected.why: Correlated restatement of C1; lacks the atrophic subtype despite epidermal atrophy.
Follicular keratotic features only; no flat-topped papules, pruritus, bandlike infiltrate, or epidermal atrophy; typical KP distribution absent.
Only nonspecific follicular/flat-topped papules; no lichenoid or atrophic histopath support; no nutritional deficiency context.
Adds only chronicity to R2; does not address lichenoid infiltrate, epidermal atrophy, or homogenized collagen.
Adds only chronicity to R4; no lichenoid or atrophic histopath support.
Adds only chronicity to R3; does not explain bandlike infiltrate or epidermal atrophy.
